package.name: aubo_e5_controllers
package.description: Locally rewritten ros2_control controller plugins for the AUBO E5 driver: AuboPassthroughTrajectoryController (whole-trajectory passthrough over the trajectory_passthrough GPIO contract) and AuboIOController (board/tool IO, robot status and RIB status). Written after the Universal Robots ur_controllers sources (Jazzy), with ur_msgs replaced by aubo_msgs/std_msgs and behavior semantics aligned with the field-tested aubo_boot driver.
